gen-gf-goldman-gf-sen: Wide, loud and round like open parentheses, that is Goldman up top. Sen follows with tall lowercase and a single constant line weight, its curves stopping short before they turn inward.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee keeps its terminals well clear of the stem and its mean line high, so the text feels open and friendly. Paprika above it is the loud one, scattered and capital-like in lowercase.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-odia: Expressive Paprika scatters its letters wide, while Anek Odia keeps its rounds open like an unlatched hook. Capitals rise only slightly above the lowercase in Anek Odia, keeping text tidy.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-tamil: Loud, scattered, huge: Paprika fills the line with lowercase that acts like capitals, and its counters breathe wide. Anek Tamil keeps big round bowls, so paragraphs should flow easily.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anek-telugu: Loud, scattered and almost capital-hungry, that is Paprika at the top. Anek Telugu reads smoothly across many lines, its wide, tall bowls setting the rhythm and leaving rounds unsealed.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-anuphan: Loud and spread out, Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, with counters that breathe open. Anuphan's big round bowls and clear gaps make paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-arimo: Tall mean line, wide gaps in rounded glyphs: the body text reads freely. Arimo takes that role under Paprika, whose scattered, capital-like lowercase makes a loud heading that deserves real size.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-athiti: Approachable Athiti looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, with a high mean line and open s gaps. Paprika's scattered, commanding heading is clearly the louder voice of the two.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like stencil bridges pulled wide, with capitals that feel clipped beside the lowercase. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono carries long text easily under Paprika's loud scatter.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-biryani: Loud and scattered, Paprika fills the line, while Biryani draws open, unclogged small counters with a fixed pen. Paprika earns its keep when it runs big and stays short.
